matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Taking or providing bereavement leave from work, including leave following pregnancy loss and parental bereavement.
Discover UK employment guidance for Bereavement leave and pregnancy loss. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
You and your partner may be able to take time off work if your child dies before they turn 18, or if you have a stillbirth after 24 weeks of pregnancy.

If the bereavement was on or after 6 April 2026, the rules on eligibility are different if you’re employed in Northern Ireland.

You might be entitled to leave, pay or both. You may be eligible for:

Parental Bereavement Leave

Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay

There are rules about when you can take your leave and pay and how to claim.

This guide is also available in Welsh (Cymraeg).

Employment rights when on leave

Your employment rights are protected while on Parental Bereavement Leave. This includes your right to:

pay rises

build up (‘accrue’) holiday

return to work
